snippet.title: Unexpected Tasks | New Time Management Game
snippet.description:
Forget your worries and dive into a cozy time management adventure.

A simple and engaging game that's easy to learn and fun to play at your own pace — with or without a timer.

Add Unexpected Tasks to your Steam wishlist to stay up to date with the latest news:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1322780/Unexpected_Tasks/
